applicability_policy: Bank deposits are not generic corporate debt; broker money funds include client deposits. Nonfinancial ratios exclude J66/J67. No financial field assigns an Agent response or stock direction.
column_policy: Actual table header dates, consolidation/parent hierarchy and horizontal columns are checked. Preparation dates and January-accounting adjustment tables are excluded. A unique complete reconciled nonparent table is required.

number_policy: Decimal values and reported units; a blank, dash, absent or ambiguous cell remains null; explicit numeric zero is retained. No zero imputation and no borrowing aggregation from unknown components.
source_policy: Use each selected original report with its own conservative next-midnight availability proxy, including revised reports. Contemporary PDF bytes are not certified as unchanged historical snapshots.
verification_policy: Full-cohort numeric candidates require an independent PDF table/line re-read before any derived state export. Complete-page assistant visual anchors cover representative layout hazards, not every field of all 123 reports.
